## What happened

An org built ten characters with the interview agent on 2026-11-02. From early 2026-11-03 every attempt to start another interview showed **"Couldn't start the interview — Something went wrong reaching the character library"** and Try again never helped.

Backend logs show ally-be refusing every `POST /v1/scenario-characters/interview/sessions` with:

> 403 `Your organisation already has 10 interviews in progress. Finish or discard one before starting another.`

## Root cause

- `CHARACTER_INTERVIEW_MAX_ACTIVE_SESSIONS_PER_TENANT = 10` counted **every** ACTIVE `character_interview_sessions` row.
- Nothing ever left ACTIVE except a saved draft (COMPLETED). Leave, Start over, a second browser or a cleared tab only dropped the localStorage pin, so each walked-away interview kept a slot forever.
- Both web apps caught the 403 and discarded the server's message for the generic copy, so nobody could tell it apart from an outage, and there was no way to "discard one" anyway.

## Fix

**ally-be**
- The in-progress cap counts only ACTIVE sessions touched within the last hour (`CHARACTER_INTERVIEW_ACTIVE_SESSION_IDLE_MS`). `updatedAt` is already bumped on every appended turn. An idle session costs nothing and can still be resumed; it just no longer blocks anyone.
- New `ABANDONED` status (varchar column — **no migration**) and `POST /v1/scenario-characters/interview/sessions/:id/abandon`: owner only, idempotent, COMPLETED sessions left alone so their draft stays openable.
- A turn on an ABANDONED session throws `NotFoundException`, which the controller already tags `session_not_found` so the web silently starts afresh and replays the message.
- `DATA_SCHEMA.md` row updated (it also still said "max 5 ACTIVE").

**ally-web (helpline + admin)**
- Leave and Start over call the abandon endpoint, fire-and-forget.
- A failed start shows the server's own message (helpline: error screen and toast; admin: toast) and falls back to the generic line only when there is none.

## Tests
- ally-be: full jest suite green (947 suites). New: idle-window count, abandon (owner / completed / foreign / unknown), orchestrator refuses an ABANDONED session, migration up/down SQL.
- ally-web: `CharacterInterview` tests in both apps green (server reason shown, generic fallback, abandon on Leave / Start over). Full admin + helpline suites green apart from the 8 pre-existing local snapshot quoting mismatches in unrelated pages.

## Repairing the already-stuck rows
Migration `1980870000000-AbandonStaleCharacterInterviewSessions` marks every ACTIVE session idle for over an hour ABANDONED on deploy, the same way the new endpoint does. Each row is tagged in `metadata.abandonedByMigration`, so `down` restores exactly those rows and no others. No hand-run SQL needed; the affected org is unblocked the moment ally-be releases.

- The next step is the first one in plan order that is `blocked | new | approved | pending_approval`.
- `rejected` halts the plan, like `failed`. The parent goes to `failed` and the admin is notified.
